\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 249-250 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:TA-R253-first-pass-words-from-chapters-249-250}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a pension and a certificate.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a game, football, cricket, chess, a competition
  \item a tent, a swing, a banyan tree, a pair of scales, straw
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A game? (\textbf{\ta{விளையாட்டு}}, \emph{viḷaiyāṭṭu}.) Football? (\textbf{\ta{கால்பந்து}}, \emph{kālpantu}.) Cricket? (\textbf{\ta{கிரிக்கெட்}}, \emph{kiriket}.) Chess? (\textbf{\ta{சதுரங்கம்}}, \emph{cataraṅkam}.) A competition? (\textbf{\ta{போட்டி}}, \emph{pōṭṭi}.) A tent? (\textbf{\ta{கூடாரம்}}, \emph{kūṭāram}.) A swing? (\textbf{\ta{ஊஞ்சல்}}, \emph{ūñcal}.) A banyan tree? (\textbf{\ta{ஆலமரம்}}, \emph{ālamaram}.) A pair of scales? (\textbf{\ta{தராசு}}, \emph{tarācu}.) Straw? (\textbf{\ta{வைக்கோல்}}, \emph{vaikkōl}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 251-253 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:TA-R253-second-pass-words-from-chapters-251-253}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for the total and a list.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item the total, a list, a thing, a sale, an employer
  \item a mark, a university, education, mathematics, science
  \item an artist, an officer, a judge, a pension, a certificate
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
The total? (\textbf{\ta{மொத்தம்}}, \emph{mottam}.) A list? (\textbf{\ta{பட்டியல்}}, \emph{paṭṭiyal}.) A thing? (\textbf{\ta{பொருள்}}, \emph{poruḷ}.) A sale? (\textbf{\ta{விற்பனை}}, \emph{viṟpaṉai}.) An employer? (\textbf{\ta{முதலாளி}}, \emph{mutalāḷi}.) A mark? (\textbf{\ta{மதிப்பெண்}}, \emph{matippeṇ}.) A university? (\textbf{\ta{பல்கலைக்கழகம்}}, \emph{palkalaikkaḻakam}.) Education? (\textbf{\ta{கல்வி}}, \emph{kalvi}.) Mathematics? (\textbf{\ta{கணிதம்}}, \emph{kaṇitam}.) Science? (\textbf{\ta{அறிவியல்}}, \emph{aṟiviyal}.) An artist? (\textbf{\ta{கலைஞர்}}, \emph{kalaiñar}.) An officer? (\textbf{\ta{அதிகாரி}}, \emph{atikāri}.) A judge? (\textbf{\ta{நீதிபதி}}, \emph{nītipati}.) A pension? (\textbf{\ta{ஓய்வூதியம்}}, \emph{ōyvūtiyam}.) A certificate? (\textbf{\ta{சான்றிதழ்}}, \emph{cāṉṟitaḻ}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
